items.title: Will Watson Explosion Verdict Shape 3M's (MMM) Litigation Risk and Contingency Planning Narrative?
items.summary: A Harris County jury recently ordered 3M to pay US$61.5 million to Houston homeowners affected by the January 24, 2020 Watson Grinding & Manufacturing explosion, the third bellwether trial in multi-district litigation over the disaster. The verdict highlights how allegations around 3M’s servicing of gas detection and alarm systems could shape ongoing liability exposure for more than 2,000 remaining plaintiffs. items.title: What Does 3M (MMM) Face After A $61.5 Million Texas Verdict?
items.summary: 3M (NYSE:MMM) was found liable by a Harris County, Texas jury in a Watson Grinding explosion case, with a verdict totaling $61.5 million in damages to affected families.
